message_interpretation: The recovered four-bit message is an opaque index 0-15 into a state/phase-conditioned descriptor table. The four bits are also decoded into the stable axes below for inspection and conformance.

coordinate_mapping_candidates.formula: src = dst * denominator / numerator for scale numerator/denominator

coordinate_lock_rule: Implement both in the CPU reference, validate ramps/impulses/identity properties, compare on the development and validation corpus, then lock exactly one per route before holdout. Do not infer a winner without measurements.

lanczos3.formula: K(x)=1 at x=0; sinc(x)*sinc(x/3) for 0<abs(x)<3; 0 otherwise; normalize accumulated weights.

anisotropic_support.formula: Rotate source offset into tangent/normal coordinates using continuous structure-tensor orientation. Scale tangent support by st=1+rho*coherence and normal support by sn=1/(1+rho*coherence). Evaluate the selected 1-D kernel on each rotated coordinate and normalize the 2-D product weights.
anisotropic_support.rho_lock: Calibrate and lock on development/validation data.

constraints: Gain is zero for conservative descriptors.
Gain is disabled or reduced under alias/ringing risk according to locked policy.
Detail is applied before the output limiter.
No negative and positive copies of the same term may cancel under distinct message IDs.

limiters.strict_neighborhood_range: Clamp to min/max of the exact source support samples, then clamp to legal Y or C range.
limiters.calibrated_relaxed_range: Clamp to [min-alpha*(max-min), max+alpha*(max-min)] with alpha hash-locked per content class and then to legal channel range.

direct_reconstruction.spatial_domain: Evaluate each output pixel at its target coordinate from source samples; nearest-neighbor expansion is not a production substrate.
direct_reconstruction.source_aligned_phase: Preserve the source sample exactly under the locked coordinate policy unless a predeclared denoising mode is enabled; denoising is off by default.
direct_reconstruction.boundaries: Use mirrored or clamped sampling exactly as locked in geometry policy; no undefined reads.
direct_reconstruction.numeric_contract: State/message/dispatch are integer exact. Reconstruction uses either fixed-point or constrained Float32; cross-device output tolerance is declared and tested.

distinctness_gate.descriptor_unique: All 16 descriptor records must differ in at least one semantically active field.
distinctness_gate.behavioral_unique: Across the synthetic operator-discrimination suite, each descriptor must differ from every other descriptor on at least one qualifying nonconstant patch. Constant-patch equality is expected and not a failure.
distinctness_gate.no_cancellation: No pair may be universally equivalent because equal and opposite terms cancel.

fallback.descriptor: Keys cubic, isotropic, conservative, strict limiter
fallback.nearest_neighbor: Test/control only; not a normal production candidate.
